## 1. Impulse and Momentum

Forces integrate to momentum change. This is an exact consequence of
infinitesimal superposition.

## 2. Work and Energy

Power integrates to energy change. Virtual work accumulates linearly
along nonlinear trajectories.

## 3. Sensitivity and Influence

Integrated variations quantify sensitivity of final state to
infinitesimal causes, not fractional causation.
